Universal testing machines Inspekt
Product catalog summary
Overview: The document provides a comprehensive overview of the Inspekt series of static electromechanical universal testing machines by Hegewald & Peschke. These machines are designed to perform a wide range of tests, including tensile, compression, bending, and torsion tests, and are adaptable to various testing conditions.
Specifications: The Inspekt series offers high measurement accuracy and versatility, suitable for both industry and research. The machines can handle high-strength materials and larger components due to their robust construction and electromechanical drive system. They comply with DIN EN ISO 6892 and DIN EN ISO 7500 standards for metal tensile testing and load measurements, respectively.
Features: The machines feature a modular design with variable geometry load frames, allowing for customization to test special specimens and components. They are equipped with high-precision strain gauge load transducers and the Electronic Drive 5 control system for synchronous data acquisition. The LabMaster software facilitates easy test execution and documentation.
Environmental Simulation: Inspekt machines can simulate various environmental conditions using climatic and temperature chambers, enabling tests under extreme conditions such as sub-zero temperatures or high heat.
Special Solutions: Hegewald & Peschke offers custom testing machines for unique testing requirements, leveraging the modular design of the Inspekt series and the company's expertise in material testing.
Automation: The document highlights the automation capabilities of Inspekt machines, including fully automated test centers with six-axis robots for high-speed, operator-independent testing.
Service and Modernization: Hegewald & Peschke provides extensive services, including on-site commissioning, calibration, and modernization of existing machines to current technological standards. They offer various modernization options to update older machines with new controls and drives.
Additional Offerings: The company also provides machines for dynamic testing, hardness testers, length measuring devices, and maintenance services. They are certified according to ISO 9001:2008 and offer DKD calibration services.

Hegewald & Peschke develops and produces entirely individual testing machines for these cases. These client-oriented special solutions do not only have considerable test engineering advantages. Inspekt automation solutions
Entirely automatic.
An increasing number of companies rely on fully automated testing machines for their materials, semi-finished products and end products. An automated test centre from Hegewald & Peschke offers high test speeds, operator independent evaluation and automated registration of the test results. The core of the plant is a universal testing machine of the type Inspekt. All the handling tasks necessary for the test procedure are undertaken by a fully automatically working six-axis robot.
